result.summary: The image depicts a commercial urban street with sidewalks on both sides but lacks marked pedestrian crossings or refuge areas. The presence of tram tracks and the absence of traffic calming measures create a moderately hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Tram tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway can cause tripping for pedestrians or catch bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway extending into the distance

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No visible painted crossings at the intersection, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.

hazards.name: Large vehicle obstruction
hazards.description: A large white truck parked or idling in the lane blocks sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic light infrastructure.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane commercial corridor with high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and a dedicated green bike lane. Despite these features, the lack of a pedestrian refuge island and the significant crossing distance across multiple travel lanes create high exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four travel lanes and a bike lane without a mid-block refuge, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, across the main roadway

hazards.name: Multiple Threat Risk
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration allows for a 'multiple threat' scenario where one vehicle stops for a pedestrian but masks a vehicle in the adjacent lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the width of the roadway

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated amber LEDs to the crossing to increase driver yield rates at this unsignalized location.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and a bus shelter. However, the wide roadway and presence of large parked vehicles near the crossing points create visibility hazards and increase exposure time for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicle
hazards.description: A large white van parked near the corner obstructs the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street in the foreground

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical buffer such as trees or bollards between the sidewalk and the moving traffic lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk on both sides of the street

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to reduce crossing distance and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a vertical buffer for pedestrians and encourage lower vehicle speeds through psychological narrowing of the road.
